action: From the signed-in dashboard, click the sidebar entry for Transactions.
reset: Run from the seed (beforeRun). Read-only.
expectedStateChange: The URL hash becomes #/transactions, the Transactions heading is shown, and the table lists seeded transactions with a non-empty pagination total.

action: On Transactions, click the Add transaction button.
reset: Run from the seed (beforeRun). Read-only until saved.
expectedStateChange: The transaction dialog opens in add mode with an empty description field, and the table row count is unchanged.

action: On Transactions, type a word from a seeded description into the search field and wait for the debounced results.
reset: Run from the seed (beforeRun). Read-only.
expectedStateChange: The filtered total is lower than the unfiltered total before the search, and every visible row description contains the typed word.

action: On Transactions, click the next-page control of the table.
reset: Run from the seed (beforeRun). Read-only. The seed holds at least 21 transactions. This case runs before any write case.
expectedStateChange: The pagination range label changes from the first-page range to the second-page range, and the first visible row differs from the first row of page one.

action: On Transactions, click the edit icon of the first row.
reset: Run from the seed (beforeRun). Read-only until saved.
expectedStateChange: The edit dialog opens in edit mode with that row's description and amount prefilled, and the table is unchanged.

action: On Transactions, click the delete icon of the first row and confirm the deletion dialog.
reset: Run from the seed (beforeRun). Deletes one transaction in the seeded database.
expectedStateChange: The total transaction count drops by one relative to before the step, and the deleted row's description is no longer in the table.

action: On Transactions, open Add transaction, enter a new description, an amount, an account and a category, then save.
reset: Run from the seed (beforeRun). Creates one transaction in the seeded database.
expectedStateChange: The dialog closes, the total transaction count rises by one relative to before the step, and a row with the entered description is visible.

action: On Accounts, click Add account, enter a new account name and choose the Current account type, then save.
reset: Run from the seed (beforeRun). Creates one account in the seeded database.
expectedStateChange: The dialog closes and the account list shows one more entry with the entered name.

action: On Accounts, select the Debt tab.
reset: Run from the seed (beforeRun). Read-only.
expectedStateChange: The Debt tab is selected and the listed account names differ from those shown on the All tab.

action: On Accounts, type part of a seeded account name into the search field.
reset: Run from the seed (beforeRun). Read-only.
expectedStateChange: The visible account count is lower than before the search, and every visible account name contains the typed text.

action: On Categories, click Add category, enter a new name, then save.
reset: Run from the seed (beforeRun). Creates one category in the seeded database.
expectedStateChange: The dialog closes and the category list shows one more row with the entered name.

action: On Tags, click Add tag, enter a new tag name, then save.
reset: Run from the seed (beforeRun). Creates one tag in the seeded database.
expectedStateChange: The dialog closes and the tag list shows one more entry with the entered name.

action: On Entities, click the edit icon of the first entity, change its name, then save.
reset: Run from the seed (beforeRun). Updates one entity in the seeded database.
expectedStateChange: The first entity row shows the new name and no longer shows the name it had before the step.

action: On Rules, type part of a seeded rule's text into the search field.
reset: Run from the seed (beforeRun). Read-only.
expectedStateChange: The visible rule rows are fewer than before the search, and every visible rule contains the typed text.

action: On the Budgets list, click the See more icon of the first budget.
reset: Run from the seed (beforeRun). Read-only.
expectedStateChange: The URL hash changes to a budget details route for that budget, and the details page shows its "Monthly budget" heading and the month of the row clicked.

action: On the Budgets list, tick the Only opened checkbox.
reset: Run from the seed (beforeRun). Read-only. The seed holds at least one closed budget.
expectedStateChange: The checkbox is checked and the visible budget rows are fewer than before the step.

action: On the Budgets list, click the matrix view button.
reset: Run from the seed (beforeRun). Read-only.
expectedStateChange: The URL hash becomes #/budgets/matrix and the budget matrix renders its month columns.

action: On Goals, select the Completed view.
reset: Run from the seed (beforeRun). Read-only.
expectedStateChange: The Completed view is selected, and the goals table lists fewer goals than before the step, each with the Completed status.

action: On Goals, click the add goal button.
reset: Run from the seed (beforeRun). Read-only until saved.
expectedStateChange: The add-goal dialog opens and the visible goal list is unchanged.

action: On Stats, select the Expenses tab.
reset: Run from the seed (beforeRun). Read-only.
expectedStateChange: The Expenses tab is selected and the panel content changes from the previously shown panel to the expenses panel.

action: On Stats, select the Year by year tab.
reset: Run from the seed (beforeRun). Read-only.
expectedStateChange: The Year by year tab is selected, and the previous panel is replaced by the Income By Category and Expenses By Category tables for the chosen year.

action: On the Dashboard, change the month picker to the previous month.
reset: Run from the seed (beforeRun). Read-only. The seed holds transactions in at least two months.
expectedStateChange: The month label changes, and the dashboard's category distribution differs from its value before the step.

action: On Profile, open the theme section and select the dark theme.
reset: Run from the seed (beforeRun). Saves the theme preference for the seeded user.
expectedStateChange: The dark theme option is checked and the computed background colour of the page body changes from its value before the step.

action: On Profile, select the Français language option.
reset: Run from the seed (beforeRun). Saves the language preference for the seeded user. Runs last because it changes UI labels.
expectedStateChange: The interface labels switch to French, including the Profile heading, and the Français option is checked.
